recent_en: Polymer Link declared a second single-tier interim dividend of 0.3 sen per share, with ex-date on 11 Sep 2026 and payment on 25 Sep 2026. For the quarter ended 30 Jun 2026, revenue was MYR39.049 million and net income MYR3.515 million, a net margin of 9.0%. News reported the company is eyeing more shipments from Europe for 2027.
notable_en: Declared a second single-tier interim dividend of 0.3 sen per share.
Net income for the quarter ended 30 Jun 2026 rose 136.9% quarter-on-quarter.
News reported the company is eyeing more shipments from Europe for 2027.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 Jun 2026, revenue was MYR39.049 million, up 1.4% QoQ and 5.1% YoY; net income was MYR3.515 million, up 136.9% QoQ and 9.2% YoY; net margin was 9.0% versus 3.9% in the prior quarter.
